officialSources.operator: Yanjiao High-tech Industrial Development Zone government / Sanhe municipal government office

This is direct local service-custodian evidence, not merely national agency prose.

officialSources.evidence: Official local government homepage identifies the Yanjiao high-tech zone and its public administration site. It was directly retrieved with HTTP 200.

officialSources.operator: Sanhe Municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau via Sanhe government information disclosure
officialSources.evidence: First-party Sanhe government information identifies the municipal Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as the authority for natural-resources administration, including land-use and cadastral-adjacent oversight. requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Direct bounded curl retrieval succeeded with verified TLS. HTML contained ordinary site navigation and a site-map link, but no parcel viewer, ArcGIS service, WFS, FeatureServer, or parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.
Official announcement was readable in the public search result and identified the Yanjiao real-property registration hall and service phone. No parcel feature response was returned.

Direct bounded request failed to connect within 8 seconds. This is a transport limitation, not evidence that Sanhe/Yanjiao lacks cadastral data. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, or TLS-disablement was used.

Public indexed government information page exposed the Sanhe government disclosure directory and the Natural Resources and Planning Bureau as a department. It did not expose a parcel viewer or anonymous parcel API.

coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: No point or parcel response was obtained. This is an endpoint/availability limitation, not evidence of citywide absence; the WUP point was not shifted.
